description: Ask YOUR linked human to approve a DESCRIBED action. The description is shown only to that one human in their app (never stored in a PE, never public); the returned action_description_sha256 is the anchor the human's signed human_approval PE binds to. Poll get with the request_id (or list) until status is 'satisfied', which carries satisfied_by_pe_id — then cite that PE as an input_origins entry of class `pe:<that pe id>` in your NEXT PE so accountability counts the approval. Never send secrets/PII in the description. Requires agent API credentials + wallet_id + a linked human.

action_description.description: A short human-readable description of the action you want approved (shown only to your linked human). No secrets/PII.

subject_pe_id.description: Optional: a PE id this action concerns.

name: request_human_approval
